Connections and handoff

GitHub stores code, research reports and operating rules. The shared Google Sheet stores workflow state and audit history. HubSpot and Athena checks remain manual until Jeff supplies access and approves field mapping.

Activation assigns research work; it does not launch a paid research provider. Add verified findings and a GitHub report before QA. Route approval never authorizes a message. This dashboard has no sending controls.
